warnings.text: Maximum temperatures in the mid thirties to low forties and overnight minimum temperatures in the mid to high twenties. Severe to extreme heatwave conditions are expected to continue over the Tiwi and Arnhem districts for the next few days before gradually easing over the Arnhem district next week.
